'''Amry''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] who served with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. By [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], Amry, a combat trained [[Officer/Legends|officer]], had achieved the [[police rank]] of [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] and was in charge of a unit of the [[Special Weapons Team]]. In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], Amry and his [[Special forces/Legends|special ops]] team accompanied [[Prefect (Coruscant police)/Legends|Prefect]] [[Pol Haus]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Kalibar Droosh]] to a supposed criminal hideout in a [[Hovertrain/Legends|maglev train]]. However, the train was rigged and exploded, wounding several of Army's men.<ref name="LastJedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
Amry was first mentioned in the [[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']], a novel by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Maya Kaathryn Bohnhoff]] that was released on [[February 26]], [[2013]].
